operations.name: listItemFeeds

args.name: feedMode
args.description: Filter by feed mode (FULL or DELTA). If not specified, returns all available feeds.

operations.desc:
Get available item feed metadata list.
    Use this to discover available feeds before fetching actual data.
    Returns feed metadata including ID, date, total count, and feed mode (FULL/DELTA).

operations.name: getItemFeedData

args.name: datafeedId
args.description: Composite datafeed ID obtained from listItemFeeds (format: {datafeedId}_{feedMode}_{grassDate}, e.g. "12345_FULL_20260205")

operations.desc:
Fetch item feed data with pagination.
    Use datafeedId from listItemFeeds to retrieve actual product data.
    Supports both FULL sync (complete dataset) and DELTA sync (incremental changes).
    DELTA mode includes updateType field (NEW/UPDATE/DELETE) for each row.
